questions.stem: A substance is made up of only one type of atom and cannot be broken down into simpler substances by chemical means. What type of substance is this?

options.text: A mixture
A molecule
A compound
An element

questions.explanation: An element is a pure substance made of only one type of atom that cannot be broken down by chemical means. There are about 118 known elements.

questions.stem: Water (H₂O) is made from hydrogen and oxygen chemically bonded in a fixed ratio. Hydrogen is a flammable gas and oxygen supports combustion, yet water puts out fires. What does this demonstrate?

options.text: Hydrogen and oxygen are not really present in water
Water is a mixture of hydrogen and oxygen
Water can be separated by physical methods
The properties of a compound are different from those of its constituent elements

questions.explanation: Compounds have completely different properties from the elements they are made of. Water is a compound where hydrogen and oxygen are chemically bonded, giving it entirely new properties.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a key characteristic of a mixture?

options.text: Its components are chemically bonded together
It can only be separated by chemical reactions
It has a fixed chemical formula
Its components can be separated by physical methods

questions.explanation: Mixtures can be separated by physical methods such as filtration and distillation because the substances are not chemically bonded together.

questions.stem: Air contains approximately 78% nitrogen, 21% oxygen, and 1% other gases. Why is air classified as a mixture rather than a compound?

options.text: Because air contains more than two substances
Because the gases in air are not chemically bonded and the proportions can vary
Because air contains only elements
Because air is invisible

questions.explanation: Air is a mixture because the gases are not chemically bonded together, the proportions can vary, and the individual gases retain their own properties.

questions.stem: Bronze is made from copper and tin. Which of the following statements about bronze is correct?

options.text: Bronze is an element because it has its own properties
Bronze is a compound because it contains two elements
Bronze is a mixture because the copper and tin are not chemically bonded in fixed proportions
Bronze is a compound because it requires chemical reactions to separate it

questions.explanation: Bronze is a mixture (an alloy) because the copper and tin atoms are mixed together but not chemically bonded in fixed proportions. The composition of bronze can vary.

questions.stem: Which row correctly compares compounds and mixtures?

options.text: Compounds have variable composition; mixtures have fixed composition
Compounds have fixed composition; mixtures have variable composition
Compounds are separated physically; mixtures are separated chemically
Compounds retain individual properties; mixtures have new properties

questions.explanation: Compounds have a fixed ratio of atoms (fixed composition) and require chemical methods to separate. Mixtures have variable composition and can be separated by physical methods.

questions.stem: Sodium chloride (NaCl) is a compound used as table salt. How could sodium chloride be separated into sodium and chlorine?

options.text: By a chemical reaction such as electrolysis
By evaporation
By distillation
By filtration

questions.explanation: Compounds can only be separated into their constituent elements by chemical reactions. Electrolysis is a chemical process that can break down sodium chloride into sodium and chlorine. Physical methods like filtration and distillation cannot break chemical bonds.
